name: Grid-Guided NeRF Branch Training
definition: A second stage where a NeRF branch is trained jointly with the pre-trained grid branch. The grid features guide NeRF sampling to concentrate on the scene surface, while NeRF provides high-frequency details via positional encoding.
summary: Grid-Guided NeRF Branch Training is a two-stage optimization that uses a pre-trained feature grid to guide NeRF sampling and explicitly couples grid features with positional encoding for joint optimization.
